capabilities: Paginate Table, Cards, and List base views using the native result limit as page size
Search an individual table column from its header with value suggestions
Assign a template or a command to the native New button per Base
Toggle pagination temporarily via commands without editing the .base file
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Pagination toggle is session-only and does not modify the .base file.
intentEvidence: It works with the built-in views instead of replacing them.
problem: Native Bases views lack pagination and per-column filtering, and the New button always creates notes the same way, which is limiting for large tables.
summary: Adds pagination, per-column search, and template or command actions on the New button to Obsidian's native Bases views.
